name: Cloudflare Browser Run Free
free_limit: 10 minutes total browser execution time/day on Workers Free; 3 concurrent browser sessions/account
watch_out: The daily 10-minute Browser Run allowance is shared by Quick Actions and browser sessions. New browser sessions are limited to one every 20 seconds; browser timeout is 60 seconds and Quick Actions are capped at 1 request every 10 seconds. /crawl additionally permits 5 crawl jobs/day and up to 100 pages/job on Free; paid usage has separate charges.
